run_face_blur_on_image: run the ego blur demo to detect and blur faces in a single input image
run_license_plate_blur_on_image: run the ego blur demo to detect and blur license plates in a single input image
run_face_and_lp_blur_on_video: run the ego blur demo to detect and blur faces and license plates in a video
run_blur_with_scaled_detections: run the ego blur demo with a scale factor to blur a larger area around detections
run_blur_with_custom_thresholds: run the ego blur demo with custom confidence and NMS thresholds for face and license plate detection
